source.title: Simply B1 Preliminary for Schools: 8 Complete Practice Tests
source.questions: Original student-book pages supplied by the user.
source.answerKey: WordHop-authored answer key and English explanations based on the supplied recordings; not a publisher key.

parts.title: Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.prompt: Which job has the girl decided to do?

optionText.A: Working as a shop assistant behind a till.
optionText.C: Working as a nurse beside a patient in bed.

questions.explanation: She decides to become a nurse because she enjoys looking after sick people. Shop assistant is an earlier possibility, and teacher is her friend’s suggestion.
questions.evidence: But I like better to work as a nurse. I enjoy looking after people who are sick. So that’s what I’ll do.
questions.explanationVi: Cô quyết định làm y tá vì thích chăm sóc người ốm. Nhân viên bán hàng là lựa chọn trước đó, còn giáo viên là gợi ý của bạn cô.

questions.prompt: What will the boy order?
questions.explanation: The boy’s first suggestion is pizza, and he returns to that first choice at the end. The girl decides to have salad after rejecting the burgers.
questions.evidence: Okay then, I’ll take my first choice.
questions.explanationVi: Cậu đề xuất pizza đầu tiên và cuối cùng quay lại lựa chọn đó. Cô gái chọn salad sau khi không chọn bánh hamburger.

questions.prompt: Which activity does the girl not do anymore?
questions.explanation: She has given up table tennis because she has no time. She now practises volleyball and still has weekly guitar lessons.
questions.evidence: Although I’ve given up, as I don’t have enough time to play anymore
questions.explanationVi: Cô đã bỏ bóng bàn vì không có thời gian. Hiện cô tập bóng chuyền và vẫn học ghi-ta hằng tuần.

questions.prompt: What does the boy want to buy tomorrow?
questions.explanation: He wants help choosing a new coat for the trip to Iceland. He will borrow his brother’s scarf, and his mum will buy his gloves online.
questions.evidence: I need you to help me buy a new coat, as next month I’ll be going on a school trip to Iceland.
questions.explanationVi: Cậu muốn được giúp chọn áo khoác mới cho chuyến đi Iceland. Cậu sẽ mượn khăn của anh/em trai, còn mẹ sẽ mua găng tay trên mạng.

questions.prompt: Which is the boy’s sister?

optionText.A: A girl with long wavy hair, without glasses or a hat.
optionText.B: A girl with short hair and glasses, without a hat.
optionText.C: A girl with short hair, glasses and a hat.

questions.explanation: His sister has short hair and glasses, but she is not wearing her usual hat in this photo. That matches picture B.
questions.evidence: she also wears glasses ... in this picture she doesn’t wear this terrible hat
questions.explanationVi: Chị/em gái cậu có tóc ngắn và đeo kính, nhưng trong ảnh này không đội chiếc mũ thường dùng. Những chi tiết đó khớp với hình B.

questions.prompt: What sort of film will they see?

optionText.A: A romantic film, shown by a couple embracing in front of a heart.
optionText.B: An action or superhero film, shown by a superhero with a shield.
optionText.C: A detective film, shown by a detective with a magnifying glass.

questions.explanation: They finally decide to see the first suggestion, the adventure film, despite its poor reviews. The romantic film is rejected and they have already seen the detective film.
questions.evidence: So I guess we ignore the reviews and see the first one.
questions.explanationVi: Cuối cùng họ chọn gợi ý đầu tiên là phim phiêu lưu, dù phim bị đánh giá thấp. Họ không chọn phim tình cảm và đã xem phim trinh thám rồi.

questions.prompt: Where does the girl want to go on holiday?
questions.explanation: She would prefer an island holiday by the sea. She dislikes the mountain and city holidays her parents usually choose.
questions.evidence: I’d prefer to go to an island and not to the mountains
questions.explanationVi: Cô muốn đi nghỉ ở biển trên một hòn đảo. Cô không thích những kỳ nghỉ ở vùng núi hay thành phố mà bố mẹ thường chọn.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about a new girl in their class.
What is the boy’s opinion of her?

optionText.A: She’s the best student in the maths class.
optionText.B: She’s not polite with other children.
optionText.C: She’s pleasant to hang out with.

questions.explanation: The boy describes seeing her push younger children around and order them to fetch a drink. This shows that he thinks she is impolite to other children.
questions.evidence: I saw her pushing some younger kids around in the break and telling them to go and get her something to drink.
questions.explanationVi: Cậu kể đã thấy cô ấy xô đẩy các em nhỏ hơn và sai các em đi lấy đồ uống. Điều này cho thấy cậu nghĩ cô ấy bất lịch sự với trẻ khác.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about a group’s new song.
They agree that

optionText.A: their new song is as good as their old ones.
optionText.C: they have copied another band’s song.

questions.explanation: Both friends say the group’s earlier songs were more original. They do not say it copied a particular song.
questions.evidence: They used to be so original back then, but I still think this is a good song.
questions.explanationVi: Cả hai đều thấy các bài hát trước đây của nhóm độc đáo hơn. Họ không nói nhóm đã sao chép một bài hát cụ thể.

questions.prompt:
You will hear a girl telling a friend about something she bought online.
What does the boy say about his experience?

optionText.A: He didn’t get his money back immediately.
optionText.B: He kept being sent the wrong size.
optionText.C: He was not able to return the item.

questions.explanation: He returned an item that was the wrong size, but waited six months for his refund. He does not describe repeated deliveries or being unable to return it.
questions.evidence: The size was all wrong and then it took six months to get a refund.
questions.explanationVi: Cậu trả lại món hàng sai kích cỡ nhưng phải chờ sáu tháng mới được hoàn tiền. Cậu không nói hàng bị giao nhiều lần hay mình không thể trả hàng.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about their teacher.
What do they disagree about?

optionText.A: whether their teacher is being reasonable or not
optionText.B: which student got the highest mark
optionText.C: whether the boy’s exam marks were good

questions.explanation: The boy thinks the teacher is being unfair. Although his friend is initially sympathetic, she disputes his claim about nationality and points out that he does not participate much in class. They agree that his exam marks were good.
questions.evidence: To be fair you are not the most active student in class.
questions.explanationVi: Cậu cho rằng giáo viên đối xử không công bằng. Ban đầu bạn cậu thông cảm, nhưng sau đó không đồng ý với lý do về quốc tịch và nhắc rằng cậu ít tham gia bài học; cả hai công nhận điểm thi của cậu tốt.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about a new film.
What does the boy think?

optionText.A: The film was better than the book.
optionText.B: The book was more detailed than the film.
optionText.C: The film was not worth watching just for the scenery.

questions.explanation: He says the book was better because the film omitted events explaining the boy’s behaviour. He also thinks the scenery makes the film worth seeing.
questions.evidence: The film did not show any of the events which explained the reasons behind the boy’s actions
questions.explanationVi: Cậu thấy sách hay hơn vì phim bỏ những sự việc giải thích cách hành xử của cậu bé trong truyện. Cậu cũng cho rằng phong cảnh khiến phim đáng xem.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about blogs.
How does the boy feel about his blog now?

optionText.A: confused by online information about blogs
optionText.B: confident that he has a nice blog
optionText.C: disappointed by the comments he has received

questions.explanation: He now feels confident: his blog is doing well and readers have left nice comments. The confusion he describes belongs to when he first started.
questions.evidence: now I’m very familiar with it and my blog’s doing pretty well
questions.explanationVi: Giờ cậu cảm thấy tự tin vì blog phát triển tốt và độc giả để lại lời nhận xét tích cực. Cảm giác bối rối chỉ có lúc cậu mới bắt đầu.

parts.title: Part 3
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one or two words or a number or a date or a time.
parts.heading: Chiswick House and Gardens Review
parts.context: You will hear a student giving a review of his visit to Chiswick House and Gardens to his class.

questions.prompt: Chiswick Park is in: ________
questions.explanation: The student locates Chiswick Park in West London. The two words complete the location note.
questions.evidence: in West London
questions.explanationVi: Học sinh nói Chiswick Park nằm ở West London. Cần cả hai từ để hoàn thành thông tin vị trí.

questions.prompt: Chiswick House contains: paintings and ________
questions.explanation: The house contains important paintings and furniture. Use the uncountable noun furniture, with no added article.
questions.evidence: there are important paintings and furniture in it
questions.explanationVi: Ngôi nhà có các bức tranh và đồ nội thất quan trọng. “Furniture” là danh từ không đếm được, không thêm mạo từ.

questions.prompt: Individual ticket for House tour costs: £ ________
questions.explanation: The house tour costs £18 per person. £38 is the family ticket price, so it does not fit the individual-ticket note.
questions.evidence: They last an hour and cost £18 per person. There are also family tickets that cost £38.
questions.explanationVi: Giá tham quan nhà là £18 mỗi người. £38 là vé gia đình nên không phù hợp với chỗ ghi giá vé cá nhân.

questions.prompt: Things to buy in flower shop: ________ and souvenirs
questions.explanation: He says visitors can buy plants and souvenirs in the flower shop. The plural plants completes the note before “and souvenirs.”
questions.evidence: There is also a flower shop where you can buy plants and souvenirs.
questions.explanationVi: Khách có thể mua cây và quà lưu niệm ở cửa hàng hoa. Từ số nhiều “plants” đứng trước cụm “and souvenirs”.

questions.prompt: Group ticket cost for garden tour: £ ________
questions.explanation: The garden tour costs £50 for a group of ten. £6 is the individual price.
questions.evidence: The garden tour is 6 pounds per person or 50 for a group of 10.
questions.explanationVi: Chuyến tham quan vườn có giá £50 cho nhóm mười người. £6 là giá dành cho một người.

questions.prompt: Starting date of Music Week: ________
questions.explanation: Music Week starts on 7 June. The 13 June date is when it ends.
questions.evidence: if you’re in London from 7th June there is a music week
questions.explanationVi: Tuần lễ âm nhạc bắt đầu ngày 7 tháng 6. Ngày 13 tháng 6 là ngày kết thúc.

parts.title: Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.context: You will hear an interview with a young athlete called Miguel.

questions.prompt: What are Parkour athletes expected to do?

optionText.A: use their body as well as equipment to move across an area.
optionText.B: use equipment efficiently to get from one point to another.
optionText.C: use only their body to move across a challenging area.

questions.explanation: Parkour athletes cross an area using only their bodies. Miguel explicitly says they use no equipment.
questions.evidence: without using any equipment, only the ability of their body
questions.explanationVi: Người tập Parkour vượt qua một khu vực chỉ bằng cơ thể mình. Miguel nói rõ họ không dùng thiết bị.

questions.prompt: What do most athletes find hard to do, according to Miguel?

optionText.A: use every part of their body
optionText.C: use equipment to jump from great heights

questions.explanation: Miguel identifies self-control as the main difficulty, especially controlling fear of heights and other challenges.
questions.evidence: There is no room for being scared ... the mind needs to control any worries about height or difficulties
questions.explanationVi: Miguel cho rằng khó khăn chính là tự kiểm soát bản thân, đặc biệt là kiểm soát nỗi sợ độ cao và những thử thách khác.

questions.prompt: Miguel says that, in the UK, Parkour

optionText.A: has already been recognised as a sport.
optionText.B: has already been part of school sports.
optionText.C: is a well-paid sport to be involved in.

questions.explanation: The UK has already recognised Parkour as a sport. Its inclusion in school sport is described as a future possibility.
questions.evidence: the UK has become the first country in the world to recognise it as a sport
questions.explanationVi: Vương quốc Anh đã công nhận Parkour là một môn thể thao. Đưa môn này vào hoạt động thể thao ở trường mới chỉ là khả năng trong tương lai.

questions.prompt: What does Miguel say about the video?

optionText.A: It was positive for the sport.

questions.explanation: The video increased negative reactions because an athlete was filmed on ancient buildings. People said this should be forbidden; Miguel does not say the video itself was banned.
questions.evidence: This was not helped by the video ... Many people didn’t like him
questions.explanationVi: Đoạn video khiến có thêm phản ứng tiêu cực vì quay một vận động viên trên các công trình cổ. Mọi người nói hành động đó nên bị cấm; Miguel không nói chính video đã bị cấm.

questions.prompt: What does Miguel say about the competition in Santorini?

optionText.A: People can only watch it online.
optionText.B: It will be quite easy for him to do well in it.
optionText.C: He could be offered a job because of it.

questions.explanation: The publicity from the competition can bring athletes career opportunities. It is a real challenge and can be watched on television as well as social media.
questions.evidence: they become famous and get offered career opportunities
questions.explanationVi: Sự chú ý từ cuộc thi có thể mang lại cơ hội nghề nghiệp cho vận động viên. Đây là thử thách thực sự và có thể xem trên ti vi cũng như mạng xã hội.

questions.prompt: In the future Miguel wants to

optionText.B: deal with Parkour as a job.

questions.explanation: Miguel wants to finish school and possibly study sports at university. He says he does not want to become a professional Parkour trainer.
questions.evidence: I would like to finish my school first and maybe study sports at university.
questions.explanationVi: Miguel muốn học xong phổ thông và có thể học ngành thể thao ở đại học. Cậu nói mình không muốn trở thành huấn luyện viên Parkour chuyên nghiệp.
